policy.policy: Four integration results own architecture progress. Thirteen stages are a responsibility catalogue; fifteen review units and dotted source tasks are internal work indexes. A small REV or support/documentation fix advances neither architecture-result nor SMP-family counters. Report actual results, blocking evidence and next integration exit, not commit totals.
policy.reporting: Current source has no complete integration-result evidence:0/4 results qualified. Independently verify the unchanged twelve full SMP families; currently bootstrap alone is qualified1/12, not12 numbered test files or patch-line progress. Do not promise a family pass from a result or infer result closure from leaf counts. Family2 retains its known scheduler failure despite a later408/408 observation.
policy.submission: Publish the checked plan now without submitting the127 runtime prototype paths. Subsequent source REVs select only complete dependency-bound responsibility changes within the current integration result; preserve other hunks. Share one qualified integration producer and test cohort instead of repeating whole bootstrap for unrelated audit/support leaves. Freeze and test the complete integration candidate before counting a result.
policy.entryBoundary: Result1 includes native argument/root registration, writer exclusion and root cleanup needed to freeze a source. Result3 includes affine-resource effects, delayed destructors and unknown-owner retirement. These can be different hunks in the same primary-owned entry files. Do not create a roots -> whole FFI -> retirement -> roots dependency cycle or imply that every CFFI semantic feature must ship in result1.
policy.supportPolicy: Header/layout, C23/Darwin, incremental build and CI work accompany their actual consumers. Only required ABI/header hunks gate result1; unrelated lossless modularization remains support. Generated C attaches to its exact Scheme producer. Preserve official names, one cache/profile and fixed limits; no support-only work counts as a modern SMP outcome.
policy.gambitAmplification: Use Gambit's existing explicit safe points and GVM live-root/frame knowledge to publish complete frozen views, instead of assuming a count or stopped carrier suffices. Preserve and strengthen shared multi-shot continuation frames, logical identity versus moved addresses, tail dispatch and C portability through one source/runtime contract. No one-shot restriction, per-actor private heap model or automatic generational-GC/LLVM speedup follows. Actual reduced scan/copy/control work and added barriers/metadata must be measured on matched complete consumers.

roots.title: Frozen root population and writer lifetime
roots.replacement: Replace implicit carrier/current-thread roots by the complete RootOrigin -> RootTask contract for six admitted root kinds, canonical aliases, all managed writers/borrows and entry root obligations. Retire old scan entry paths only after all real callers are replaced.
roots.validation: Generated/reflected globals, RC nonzero processor, stack/bank/multi-shot continuation, symbol/keyword and VM roots, real close/store races, root relocation, exit/failure custody and real implementation replay/shrink. Run complete applicable original GSI/GSC consumers; any scoped baseline disposition requires its own actual source proof.
roots.falsifier: A raw admitted writer, unpinned alias, incomplete frame or late store remains; a missing or related failure cannot be dismissed as baseline.
roots.benefit: An explicit frozen root union can be scanned independently of a running carrier; no completed leaf count proves that union.
roots.cost: Actual authority acquisitions, root metadata, retained borrows and scan work must be counted; throughput and RSS remain unmeasured.

collector.title: Physical copy capacity and independent collector/restoration
collector.replacement: Replace carrier-index work arenas and local-count assumptions with unique copy authority, complete source/frame census, physical interval packing, worker-owned arenas and R-context restoration by W workers.
collector.validation: W<R and other declared topologies, reserve/refund/CAS-loss, batch/Tail custody, GC/root relocation and real map multi-shot restore. Bound physical peak and every failure/unknown result without adding heap or waits.
collector.falsifier: A worker still borrows carrier-local allocation identity, one object scans twice, a copy lacks contiguous capacity or a context lacks its first restore interval.
collector.benefit: Worker count becomes independent from execution contexts and root sources; remove repeated scanning/copy work only with measured counts.
collector.cost: Census/packing, reservations, physical slack and root/restore metadata; no invented peak-memory or throughput gain.

lifetime.title: Startup, retirement and deferred effects
lifetime.replacement: Replace member-publication/join/global-cleanup coupling by rooted startup requests, initialized physical reservations, explicit member acceptance and resource-specific ownership transfer/retirement. Separate root entry cleanup from affine native resource effects.
lifetime.validation: Partial create/rollback/retry, join failure/unknown, nested entry/exit, delayed destructors/shutdown drain and healthy VM continuing GC under an isolated unknown join; full registry/lifecycle/GC-FFI inventories.
lifetime.falsifier: Unknown join is treated as death, metadata is freed with remaining roots/readers, or healthy VMs wait for an unrelated unknown owner.
lifetime.benefit: Local uncertainty retains explicit custody and need not stop unrelated healthy VMs.
lifetime.cost: Retained unknown-owner storage, queues, tickets and accounting; quantify bounds from actual usage.

execution.title: Request execution and complete product qualification
execution.replacement: Replace waiting-thread/service-activation confusion and unowned shared FIFO publication by explicit request/message ownership, stable execution boundaries and exact completed native/Gerbil product consumers.
execution.validation: Complete original interpreted/compiled, PR and stress manifests, ordered shared values, repeated multi-shot control, complete Gerbil build/tests and matched release latency/throughput/peak populations on the final source.
execution.falsifier: Repair9 work merely moves, repeat continuation materialization persists, original populations shrink, or final product/CI/performance evidence is absent.
execution.benefit: Amplify Scheme/tail-call/multi-shot control with owned service execution and actual parallel consumers; prove reductions in repeated work on matched populations.
execution.cost: Queue/admission/GC/control overhead remains explicit; performance stays unmeasured until matched evidence exists.
